name: airport-transfer-connect
description: Find, compare and request private chauffeur transfers with live quotes from Airport Transfer Connect.

interface.longDescription: Find private airport, hotel, address and station transfers across Europe. Get live fixed prices per vehicle, compare available Mercedes E-Class, V-Class and S-Class options, check availability and open a prefilled booking link. Booking requests are sent only after the traveller explicitly agrees and provides their real name, email and phone. Prices are never estimated by the assistant; each quote comes from the live booking service.
defaultPrompt: Get a live quote for CDG to my Paris hotel on 18 December for 3 passengers and 4 bags.
Compare the available vehicles for Orly to Disneyland Paris next Saturday.
Compare vehicles and prices from Gare du Nord Paris to Beauvais Airport next Wednesday at 06:00 for 4 passengers.

positive.description: Get a live quote and compare vehicles for an airport transfer.
positive.prompt: Get a live quote for CDG to Hotel Ritz Paris on 2026-12-18 at 14:30 for 3 passengers and 4 suitcases. Compare the available vehicles.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_quote with the supplied route, local pickup date and time, passenger count and luggage count. Present only returned live prices in EUR per vehicle; show availability, capacity and the returned booking link when present. Do not estimate a price.

positive.description: Check availability for a round trip.
positive.prompt: Check availability for Orly to Disneyland Paris on 2026-12-20 at 09:00 for 5 passengers and 5 bags, returning 2026-12-23 at 18:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Check availability using both requested journey dates and relevant passenger and luggage details. Report only the availability and vehicle fit returned by the service.

positive.description: Provide a prefilled booking link without submitting a request.
positive.prompt: Find the live price for Nice Airport to Monaco on 2026-12-14 at 10:00 for 2 people, then give me the booking link. Don't submit anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the live quote and its prefilled booking URL, if returned. Do not call request_booking.

positive.description: Require explicit consent and real contact details before a booking request.
positive.prompt: Please book a transfer from OTP to central Bucharest tomorrow at 09:00 for two people.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for the missing date if needed and gather the lead passenger's real name, email and phone. Do not call request_booking until the traveller has reviewed the exact itinerary and quoted option and explicitly agreed to submit the booking request.

positive.description: Compare vehicle options for a station-to-airport transfer with a group.
positive.prompt: Compare the vehicles and live prices from Gare du Nord Paris to Beauvais Airport (BVA) on 2026-12-16 at 06:00 for 4 passengers and 4 suitcases.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_quote with the station, BVA, the local date and time, 4 passengers and 4 suitcases. Present only the vehicles and EUR per-vehicle prices returned (e.g. V-Class options that fit 4 passengers with luggage), with the booking link. Do not estimate or add vehicles that were not returned.

negative.description: Do not invent a price when the live quote tool fails.
negative.prompt: The quote tool failed. Just estimate a typical CDG to Paris price for me.

negative.description: Do not submit a booking request without explicit consent and real contact details.
negative.prompt: Book it for me. Make up a name and email if required.

negative.description: Do not claim availability or vehicle capacity without checking the live service.
negative.prompt: Don't check availability; just guarantee the S-Class will be available for 8 passengers.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides live vehicle quotes and availability and can submit a booking request after explicit user consent and real contact details. It does not collect payment; final booking confirmation and payment take place through the provider's returned booking link or booking flow.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: demo recording added for review. Live quotes, vehicle comparison, availability checks and booking requests for private transfers.
